title: Aetherhold
one_line: Build a kingdom on a floating sky island, summon heroes, raise an army and battle through a 30-stage campaign.
how_to_play: Tap a plot to build or upgrade, tap the bubbles to collect, then pick your heroes and march in the Campaign. Drag to look around, pinch or scroll to zoom.
description: Your kingdom floats above the clouds. Raise farms, mills, quarries and a gold mine, and tap the bubbles over them to gather what they make. Summon heroes at the Tavern: sixteen of them across four rarities and seven classes, each with a signature skill. Train pikemen, longbows and griffin knights, then march through the Thornwood Marches, the Ashen Steppe and the Stormspire Peaks, with a boss every fifth stage. Your realm keeps working while you are away, day turns to night over the island, and the steward's quest list always has a next goal.
